title: 'Claymore' Creator Norihiro Yagi Begins New Manga
content: Norihiro Yagi , the creator of Claymore , began serializing a new manga titled Batrlet Fairy Basslet on the Shounen Jump+ platform on Monday. Yagi serialized Claymore in Monthly Shounen Jump from June 2001 to June 2007. Following the magazine's discontinuance, the manga switched to Jump SQ.

title: 'Charisma' Unveils Additional Cast, Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of the Charisma House mixed-media project unveiled a pair of additional cast and teaser promotional video on Sunday. The anime series will premiere on TBS affiliate networks at 11:56 p.m. on January 7, 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Bocchi the Rock!' Gets Prequel Anime Movie in 2027
content: The official website of the Bocchi the Rock! anime series announced a new prequel anime movie subtitled Hoshi no Ashiato , revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement promo on Sunday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in 2027.
